notes.title: 🚨 ATTENTION, ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content: [p][b]Coming Soon: Stretcher Together[/b] – a challenging [b]3D co-op platformer[/b] where you and a teammate play as medics rescuing a patient after a bad fall.[/p][p]Work together to climb a massive [b]vertical platforming level[/b]—jump, balance, and scramble upward, but be careful not to drop your patient, or you’ll have to go back for them![/p][p][b]Wishlist now! [/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3883760/Stretcher_Together/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
